name: jud
description: Write, review, fix, run, measure, bias-test and tune .jud documents (a Rubric with its policy, the Cases it is graded on, a Recording), images and Box questions included, hold them in CI, serve them over MCP, and turn a rubric into a typed Rust module, with the judgment crate's own reader and jud command: three skills, two hooks (jud check after a .jud is written, no edit to a recording), and the /jud:rubric, /jud:cases, /jud:check, /jud:review, /jud:run, /jud:record, /jud:eval, /jud:tune, /jud:bias, /jud:compare, /jud:ci, /jud:serve and /jud:rust commands.
